observe.surface: The owner's machine: Claude Code hooks, skills, agents and rules loaded from ~/.claude, and the shell, git and editor config loaded from the home folder, all linked into the live clone ~/.windful-ocean.
observe.value: Exit codes and output of the hook scripts and the dotfiles CLI for a given input, the links the installer creates, and the messages and attached language servers of headless Neovim.
observe.observe_by: node --test over the suites in .claude/hooks/tests, .claude/lib/*/tests, .claude/skills/*/tests, scripts/repo/tests and scripts/dotfiles/tests; headless nvim for the editor config.
observe.terminal_action: Merging to main, then fast-forwarding ~/.windful-ocean and running node scripts/dotfiles/cli.mjs install, which makes the change live.
observe.build_artifact: None: the live clone ~/.windful-ocean checked out at the merged commit is what runs.
observe.twin: Rules restated across .claude/rules, .claude/CLAUDE.md and the agent bodies in .claude/agents.
observe.dependent: Claude Code sessions on this machine, zsh, git, Neovim, tmux and WezTerm, each reading the linked files.
observe.receipt: node --test <the touched test file>; npm test for the whole suite.
observe.compat_boundary: The development checkout versus the live clone ~/.windful-ocean: merged work is live only after the clone pulls, and plugin caches under ~/.claude/plugins update on their own schedule.

reach.access: A local shell in a checkout of this repository; no network service and no credentials.
reach.shortcut: Not needed: the tests point HOME at a temporary folder, so install and hook behaviour reproduces without touching the real home folder.
reach.fixtures: The tests create their own temporary homes, repositories and inputs; nothing needs seeding.
special_surfaces: Neovim editor behaviour, observed with headless nvim rather than node --test
terminal rendering in WezTerm, a GUI with no headless reader
hook behaviour inside a live Claude Code session
